findings.motion: HB 213, Voter identification; accepted forms of identification, out-of-state student identification card (introduced by him; prefiled 2019-12-27)
findings.note: Bill adds a valid student photo ID card from a college or university in any other state or territory to the accepted forms of voter ID. It passed the House 57-41 on 2020-02-11 and the Senate 21-18 on 2020-02-24, and the Governor approved it as Chapter 1154 on 2020-04-11 (effective 7/1/20).

findings.motion: 2019 session bill by Del. Rip Sullivan to allow out-of-state student photo ID cards as voter ID (House subcommittee voted 4-2 to kill it on Jan. 29; bill number not given on the page)
findings.note: InsideNoVa reports: "A subcommittee on Jan. 29 voted 4-2 to kill the measure proposed by Del. Rip Sullivan (D-48th) to allow student photo-ID cards from institutions outside the commonwealth to be used to prove identity while voting." Reporter's words, not his.

findings.motion: HB 26, Voter identification; accepted forms of identification, private entities licensed or certified, House passage (85-Y 11-N); he is listed among the YEAS
findings.note: Bill adds to the accepted voter IDs a photo ID card issued by a private entity licensed or certified by certain state health and social services agencies. Passed the Senate 21-17 on 2024-02-23; vetoed by the Governor 2024-04-08; House sustained the veto 2024-04-17.
